state.interpretation: Substantive dashboard scaffold reframed as a venture operating system, with build/typecheck tooling and broad UI/content surfaces; dedicated test/CI evidence is not established at the inspected root.

evidence.statement: package.json provides development, build, start, preview, typecheck, and formatting scripts but no test script.
evidence.limits: A repository can contain tests without a package test script; test absence is therefore not proven by this field alone.

evidence.statement: The current main commit reframes the dashboard around recurring operating cycles, service/runtime choices, evidence, validation, compliance, and product operations rather than the earlier market-dashboard copy.
evidence.limits: This establishes product content at the commit; effectiveness of the operating model remains untested.

evidence.statement: No root GitHub Actions workflow or current workflow run was established during this review.
evidence.limits: Absence of a surfaced workflow does not prove that external CI exists elsewhere.

evidence.statement: The strongest UWS relevance is as a human-facing operating-cycle presentation layer for evidence/decisions, not as the underlying orchestration or provenance substrate.
evidence.source: Synthesis of current main product surface
evidence.limits: The UI may encode useful interaction patterns, but durable state semantics are not established.

suggestions: Keep the operating-cycle UX separate from UWS authoritative state and evidence services.
Promote any repeated workflow primitive only after backing it with persisted state, explicit provenance, and tests.
unknowns: Presence and quality of test suites outside package scripts.
Whether the runtime/service selection logic is descriptive only or connected to executable provisioning.

relationships.notes: Potential UX/reference surface for recurring operating cycles; not evidence for underlying orchestration capabilities.

verification.reproducibility: Structural observation only; no root CI execution established.
falsifiers: Direct inspection reveals a durable tested operating-system core with reusable orchestration primitives.
A CI/test surface demonstrates stronger implementation evidence than the current structural review.

next_test: Inspect server/shared behavior and any existing test files, then establish whether the operating-cycle concepts are backed by durable state and verifiable transitions.
